PostgreSQL supports variable-length multidimensional arrays as column values.

vocabulary.definition: An INNER JOIN returns joined rows that satisfy its join condition.

A CROSS JOIN produces the Cartesian product of its two inputs.
Aggregate functions compute one result from a set of input values, such as count, sum, average, minimum, or maximum.
GROUP BY combines rows sharing the same grouping values so aggregate calculations can be performed per group.
HAVING filters grouped rows after grouping, while WHERE filters rows before grouping.

vocabulary.definition: A database structure that can accelerate selected lookups by maintaining an additional searchable organization of data.
A PostgreSQL transaction groups multiple statements into a single all-or-nothing unit using BEGIN and COMMIT, with ROLLBACK available to abandon the transaction.
PostgreSQL uses multiversion concurrency control so statements can work with database snapshots while concurrent transactions create new row versions.
A PostgreSQL index is a separate data structure that can speed retrieval for supported query patterns at the cost of additional storage and maintenance work.
EXPLAIN displays the query plan selected by the PostgreSQL planner without executing the query unless an execution option such as ANALYZE is requested.
EXPLAIN ANALYZE executes the query and reports actual run-time measurements in addition to plan information.

vocabulary.definition: A database structure that can accelerate selected lookups by maintaining an additional searchable organization of data.
A PostgreSQL transaction groups multiple statements into a single all-or-nothing unit using BEGIN and COMMIT, with ROLLBACK available to abandon the transaction.
PostgreSQL uses multiversion concurrency control so statements can work with database snapshots while concurrent transactions create new row versions.
A PostgreSQL index is a separate data structure that can speed retrieval for supported query patterns at the cost of additional storage and maintenance work.
EXPLAIN displays the query plan selected by the PostgreSQL planner without executing the query unless an execution option such as ANALYZE is requested.
EXPLAIN ANALYZE executes the query and reports actual run-time measurements in addition to plan information.
